parameters.help_en: The list of message IDs to query. A maximum of 100 message IDs can be included. If multiple IDs are provided, a match occurs if any ID matches. If this parameter is not specified or an empty list is provided, messages are not filtered by message ID. If no message ID matches, an empty list is returned
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的消息 ID 列表，最多包含 100 个消息 ID。多个 ID 按任意一个匹配；不传或传空列表时，不按消息 ID 筛选。没有匹配消息 ID 时返回空列表
parameters.name: message_ids

parameters.help_en: The business channel, which is used to restrict the business to which the messages to query belong. Valid values: enterprise, standard, office, business, lincore_team, and AGENTIC_CLOUD_COMPUTER. The values are not case-sensitive. Default value: enterprise. Unrecognized channel values are also processed as enterprise
parameters.help_zh: 业务渠道，用于限定待查询消息所属的业务。支持 enterprise、standard、office、business、lincore_team、AGENTIC_CLOUD_COMPUTER，不区分大小写。默认使用 enterprise；无法识别的渠道值也按 enterprise 处理
parameters.name: business_channel

parameters.help_en: The message type. Valid values: OPERATIONAL (client operational message), WALLPAPER (desktop wallpaper text message), NOTIFICATION (message center notification), and CUSTOM_WALLPAPER (custom desktop wallpaper). The values are not case-sensitive. If this parameter is not specified or the value is unrecognized, messages are not filtered by message type
parameters.help_zh: 消息类型。支持 OPERATIONAL（客户端运营消息）、WALLPAPER（桌面壁纸文本消息）、NOTIFICATION（消息中心通知）、CUSTOM_WALLPAPER（桌面自定义壁纸），不区分大小写。不传或无法识别时，不应用消息类型筛选
parameters.name: message_type

parameters.help_en: The filter list of client types to which operational messages apply. A maximum of 100 items can be included. Valid values: Windows (Windows client), Mac (macOS client), Web (web client), and Hardware (hardware terminal). For Mac, macOS is also supported. The matching is not case-sensitive. If multiple types are specified, a match occurs if any type matches. Do not pass the same type repeatedly. To filter by client type, provide a non-empty list. If this parameter is not specified, messages are not filtered by client type. Do not specify this parameter when querying NOTIFICATION messages
parameters.help_zh: 运营消息适用的客户端类型筛选列表，最多 100 项。支持 Windows（Windows 客户端）、Mac（macOS 客户端）、Web（网页客户端）、Hardware（硬件终端）；Mac 也支持 macOS，匹配不区分大小写。指定不同类型时按任意一种匹配，请勿重复传入同一类型。进行筛选时应提供非空列表；不传时不按客户端类型筛选。查询 NOTIFICATION 消息时请不传本参数
parameters.name: client_types

parameters.help_en: The message level filter condition for notification messages. Valid values: STRONG (strong message) and WEAK (weak message). The values are not case-sensitive. If this parameter is not specified or the value is unrecognized, messages are not filtered by message level. Do not specify this parameter when querying OPERATIONAL messages
parameters.help_zh: 通知消息的消息强度筛选条件。支持 STRONG（强消息）、WEAK（弱消息），不区分大小写。不传或无法识别时，不应用消息强度筛选。查询 OPERATIONAL 消息时请不传本参数
parameters.name: message_level

parameters.help_en: The search keyword, which is used to perform a fuzzy match on the message title or body. A match occurs if either the title or the body matches the keyword. If this parameter is not specified or an empty string is provided, messages are not filtered by keyword
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，对消息标题或正文进行模糊匹配。标题或正文任意一项匹配即可返回；不传或传空字符串时，不进行关键词筛选
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The target matching method. Valid values: AllUsers (all convenience users), EndUser (specified convenience user), Organization (convenience user organization), Desktop (cloud computer), ResourceGroup (resource group), Region (region), Tag (tag), AdAllUsers (all AD users), AdUser (specified AD user), and AdOrg (AD organization). The values are not case-sensitive. If TargetIds is specified, this parameter must also be specified. The target type in the query results is not guaranteed to be consistent with this parameter. If only this parameter is specified without target IDs, no target filtering is applied. Currently, Tag does not perform target filtering
parameters.help_zh: 目标匹配方式。支持 AllUsers（全部便捷用户）、EndUser（指定便捷用户）、Organization（便捷用户组织）、Desktop（云电脑）、ResourceGroup（资源组）、Region（地域）、Tag（标签）、AdAllUsers（全部 AD 用户）、AdUser（指定 AD 用户）、AdOrg（AD 组织），不区分大小写。提供 TargetIds 时必须同时提供本参数。查询结果的目标类型不保证与本参数一致；仅提供本参数而不提供目标 ID 时，不形成目标筛选。Tag 当前不执行目标筛选
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en: The list of target IDs to match. A maximum of 100 items can be included. To filter by target, provide a non-empty list and specify TargetType at the same time. Currently, only the first ID is used for Organization, EndUser, and AdUser. Queries for EndUser and AdUser also match messages targeted at the organization to which the user belongs and all users. Queries for Organization include messages for all convenience users and are compatible with fuzzy matching of organization IDs. Other target matching methods match based on target IDs, and the target type of the returned records is not guaranteed to be consistent with TargetType. Currently, Tag does not perform target ID filtering
parameters.help_zh: 待匹配的目标 ID 列表，最多 100 项。进行筛选时应提供非空列表，并同时提供 TargetType。Organization、EndUser、AdUser 当前仅使用第一个 ID。EndUser、AdUser 查询还会匹配面向所属组织及全量用户的消息；Organization 查询包含全量便捷用户消息，并兼容组织 ID 的模糊匹配。其他目标匹配方式根据目标 ID 匹配，不保证返回记录的目标类型与 TargetType 一致。Tag 当前不执行目标 ID 筛选
parameters.name: target_ids

parameters.help_en: The page number of the query result. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1. If the value is less than 1, it is processed as 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询结果页码，从 1 开始。默认值为 1；小于 1 时按 1 处理
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 200. Default value: 200. If the value is less than 1 or greater than 200, it is processed as 200
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，取值范围为 1～200，默认值为 200；小于 1 或大于 200 时按 200 处理
parameters.name: page_size

schema.description_en: The query result, including the total number of matched messages, the ID of the current request, and the message list for the current page
schema.description_zh: 查询结果，包括匹配的消息总数、本次请求 ID 和当前页消息列表

MessageList.description_en: The list of console messages queried for the current page. If no messages match, an empty list is returned
MessageList.description_zh: 当前页查询到的控制台消息列表。没有匹配的消息时返回空列表

items.description_en: The content, status, and application scope configuration of a single console message
items.description_zh: 单条控制台消息的内容、状态和适用范围配置

ClientTypes.description_en: The list of client types to which the message applies. Standard names are returned: Windows, Mac, Web, and Hardware
ClientTypes.description_zh: 消息适用的客户端类型列表。返回标准名称：Windows、Mac、Web、Hardware

items.description_en: A single client type. Valid values: Windows (Windows client), Mac (macOS client), Web (web client), and Hardware (hardware terminal)
items.description_zh: 单个客户端类型。取值：Windows（Windows 客户端）、Mac（macOS 客户端）、Web（网页客户端）、Hardware（硬件终端）

ContentConfigs.description_en: The list of message body configurations for each language
ContentConfigs.description_zh: 各语言的消息正文配置列表

items.description_en: The message body configuration for a specific language
items.description_zh: 一种语言的消息正文配置

Color.description_en: The color of the body text. The color value saved when the message is created or modified is used
Color.description_zh: 正文文字的颜色，沿用消息创建或修改时保存的颜色值

ContentText.description_en: The message body text in the specified language
ContentText.description_zh: 该语言的消息正文文字
ContentText.example: 云电脑将进行例行维护，请提前保存工作。

LangType.description_en: The body language. Valid values: CN (Chinese), EN (English), and JP (Japanese). The query returns the language value saved when the message is created or modified, retaining the original case
LangType.description_zh: 正文语言。支持 CN（中文）、EN（英文）、JP（日文）；查询返回创建或修改时保存的语言值，保留原始大小写

EndTime.description_en: The time when the operational message stops taking effect. The time is in ISO 8601 format. A time zone offset of +00:00 indicates UTC time
EndTime.description_zh: 运营消息结束生效的时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式；时区偏移为 +00:00 时表示 UTC 时间

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the message was created

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the message was last modified. This time is also updated when the message status changes
GmtModified.description_zh: 消息最近一次修改的时间；消息状态变化也会更新该时间

HyperLinkConfigs.description_en: The list of hyperlink button configurations in the message
HyperLinkConfigs.description_zh: 消息中的超链接按钮配置列表

items.description_en: The configuration of a single hyperlink button
items.description_zh: 单个超链接按钮的配置

Title.description_en: The text displayed on the hyperlink button
Title.description_zh: 超链接按钮上显示的文字

Url.description_en: The URL accessed after the hyperlink button is clicked
Url.description_zh: 点击超链接按钮后访问的地址

ImageFilePath.description_en: The storage path of the image file for the operational message
ImageFilePath.description_zh: 运营消息图片文件的存储路径

ImageInfoList.description_en: The list of image configurations, which is mainly used for custom wallpaper messages. Each item includes the image name, image type, storage path, and temporary download URL
ImageInfoList.description_zh: 图片配置列表，主要用于自定义壁纸消息。每项包含图片名称、图片类型、存储路径和临时下载地址

items.description_en: The configuration of a single image

FileName.description_en: The name of the image file

ImageFilePath.description_en: The storage path of the image file

ImageType.description_en: The image type. Configuration types defined by the backend include Operational (operational message image), WallpaperBasic (basic wallpaper image), and WallpaperAppend (appended wallpaper image). The query returns the image type value saved when the message is created or modified, retaining the original case
ImageType.description_zh: 图片类型。后端定义的配置类型包括 Operational（运营消息图片）、WallpaperBasic（基础壁纸图片）、WallpaperAppend（附加壁纸图片）。查询返回创建或修改时保存的图片类型值，保留原始大小写

ImageUrl.description_en: The temporary download URL of the image file. The link has a limited validity period. If the link expires, you can query again to obtain a new one
ImageUrl.description_zh: 图片文件的临时下载地址。链接有效期有限，失效后可重新查询获取

ImageUrl.description_en: The temporary download URL of the operational message image. The link has a limited validity period. If the link expires, you can query again to obtain a new one
ImageUrl.description_zh: 运营消息图片的临时下载地址。链接有效期有限，失效后可重新查询获取

MessageId.description_en: The message ID, which can be used to send, modify, or delete a specified message
MessageId.description_zh: 消息 ID，可用于发送、修改或删除指定消息

MessageLevel.description_en: The message level of the notification message. Valid values: STRONG (strong message) and WEAK (weak message)
MessageLevel.description_zh: 通知消息的消息强度。取值：STRONG（强消息）、WEAK（弱消息）

MessageType.description_en: The message type. Valid values: OPERATIONAL (client operational message), WALLPAPER (desktop wallpaper text message), NOTIFICATION (message center notification), and CUSTOM_WALLPAPER (custom desktop wallpaper)
MessageType.description_zh: 消息类型。取值：OPERATIONAL（客户端运营消息）、WALLPAPER（桌面壁纸文本消息）、NOTIFICATION（消息中心通知）、CUSTOM_WALLPAPER（桌面自定义壁纸）

MetaData.description_en: The additional configuration of the message, including the associated workspace, AD domain name, and scheduled sending configuration. Whether specific fields are returned depends on the message type and its saved configuration
MetaData.description_zh: 消息的附加配置，包括关联的工作区、AD 域名和定时发送配置。具体字段是否返回，取决于消息类型及其已保存的配置

AdDomain.description_en: The AD domain name associated with the message configuration
AdDomain.description_zh: 消息配置关联的 AD 域名

OfficeSiteId.description_en: The workspace ID associated with the message configuration
OfficeSiteId.description_zh: 消息配置关联的工作区 ID

Timer.description_en: The list of scheduled sending configurations. If TimerType is CRON, the elements are cron expressions. If TimerType is Timestamp, the elements are millisecond timestamps represented as strings
Timer.description_zh: 定时发送配置列表。TimerType 为 CRON 时，元素为 Cron 表达式；为 Timestamp 时，元素为以字符串表示的毫秒时间戳

items.description_en: A single scheduled sending configuration. Depending on TimerType, it is a cron expression or a millisecond timestamp represented as a string
items.description_zh: 单个定时发送配置。根据 TimerType，为 Cron 表达式或以字符串表示的毫秒时间戳

TimerType.description_en: The scheduled sending type. Valid values: CRON (cron expression) and Timestamp (timestamp). The configuration values are case-sensitive
TimerType.description_zh: 定时发送类型。支持 CRON（Cron 表达式）、Timestamp（时间戳）。配置值区分大小写

Position.description_en: The display position of the message. For wallpaper text messages, valid values are CENTER (center), TOP_RIGHT (top right), BOTTOM_RIGHT (bottom right), and BOTTOM_LEFT (bottom left). For client operational messages, valid values are CLIENT_ENTERPRISE_RESOURCE_PAGE (Enterprise Edition client cloud resource page) and CLIENT_BUSINESS_RESOURCE_PAGE (Business Edition client cloud resource page)
Position.description_zh: 消息显示位置。壁纸文本消息支持 CENTER（居中）、TOP_RIGHT（右上）、BOTTOM_RIGHT（右下）、BOTTOM_LEFT（左下）；客户端运营消息支持 CLIENT_ENTERPRISE_RESOURCE_PAGE（企业版客户端云资源页）、CLIENT_BUSINESS_RESOURCE_PAGE（商业版客户端云资源页）

StartTime.description_en: The time when the operational message starts taking effect. The time is in ISO 8601 format. A time zone offset of +00:00 indicates UTC time
StartTime.description_zh: 运营消息开始生效的时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式；时区偏移为 +00:00 时表示 UTC 时间

Status.description_en: The current status of the message. Valid values: Init (initializing), Pushing (pushing), Published (published), Expired (expired), Deleting (deleting), and Failed (failed). Published indicates that the message has been published or the server-side push processing has finished, but it does not indicate that all target terminals have successfully received the message
Status.description_zh: 消息当前状态。取值：Init（初始化中）、Pushing（推送处理中）、Published（已发布）、Expired（已过期）、Deleting（删除处理中）、Failed（处理失败）。Published 表示消息已发布或服务端推送处理结束，不表示所有目标终端均已成功收到消息

TargetIds.description_en: The JSON string of the list of targets to which the message applies. For Organization and AdOrg, it is an array of objects containing orgId (organization ID) and orgName (organization name). The organization name may be empty, and records in the old format may not contain orgName. For Tag, it is an array of objects containing tagKey (tag key), tagValue (tag value), and regionId (region ID). For other target types, it is an array of strings. The all-users target is represented by ALL_USERS
TargetIds.description_zh: 消息适用目标列表的 JSON 字符串。Organization、AdOrg 为包含 orgId（组织 ID）及 orgName（组织名称）的对象数组；组织名称可能为空，旧格式记录可能不包含 orgName。Tag 为包含 tagKey（标签键）、tagValue（标签值）、regionId（地域 ID）的对象数组；其他目标类型为字符串数组。全量用户目标使用 ALL_USERS 表示

TargetType.description_en: The type of the target to which the message applies. Valid values: AllUsers (all convenience users), EndUser (specified convenience user), Organization (specified convenience user organization), Desktop (cloud computer), ResourceGroup (resource group), Region (region), Tag (tag), AdAllUsers (all AD users), AdUser (specified AD user), and AdOrg (specified AD organization)
TargetType.description_zh: 消息适用目标的类型。取值：AllUsers（全部便捷用户）、EndUser（指定便捷用户）、Organization（指定便捷用户组织）、Desktop（云电脑）、ResourceGroup（资源组）、Region（地域）、Tag（标签）、AdAllUsers（全部 AD 用户）、AdUser（指定 AD 用户）、AdOrg（指定 AD 组织）

TitleConfigs.description_en: The list of message title configurations for each language
TitleConfigs.description_zh: 各语言的消息标题配置列表

items.description_en: The message title configuration for a specific language
items.description_zh: 一种语言的消息标题配置

Color.description_en: The color of the title text. The color value saved when the message is created or modified is used
Color.description_zh: 标题文字的颜色，沿用消息创建或修改时保存的颜色值

LangType.description_en: The title language. Valid values: CN (Chinese), EN (English), and JP (Japanese). The query returns the language value saved when the message is created or modified, retaining the original case
LangType.description_zh: 标题语言。支持 CN（中文）、EN（英文）、JP（日文）；查询返回创建或修改时保存的语言值，保留原始大小写

TitleText.description_en: The message title text in the specified language
TitleText.description_zh: 该语言的消息标题文字

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the current request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的 ID，用于定位和排查问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of messages that match the query conditions, not the number of messages returned on the current page
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的消息总数，不是当前页返回的消息条数
